appetizers-aloha-dip.title: Aloha Dip
directions: Mix together macaroons, sugar, and sour cream.
Chill for several hours to soften the crumbs. Do not stir again. (The macaroons will break into small crumbs.)
Cut off the top of the pineapple 1" below the leaves and hollow it out.
Place the dip into the pineapple, and replace the top.

appetizers-caso.title: Caso
directions: Melt chili and Velveeta together.
Serve warm with tortilla chips.

appetizers-cheese-ball.title: Cheese Ball
directions: Mix all ingredients except 1/2 cup chopped dried beef.
Shape mixture into a ball and sprinkle remaining dried beef on the top.
Chill and serve with crackers.

appetizers-chili-dip.title: Chili Dip

items: 1 pound chili block (found in meat markets)
1 can of beer (use just enough to make the mixture the right consistency)

directions: Mix and heat in a small crockpot, and serve with corn chips.

appetizers-corn-fritters.title: Corn Fritters
directions: Place corn in microwave covered with water. Cook approx. 7 min.
Drain liquid into measuring cup - add milk until you have 1 1/2 cups liquid.
Add remaining dry ingredients.
Drop by tsp. into 375°F oil. Fry 3-4 min.
Drain and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

appetizers-dill-dip.title: Dill Dip

items: 1 package (1 oz) dry ranch salad dressing mix

directions: In 1 quart bowl, combine salad dressing mix, Miracle Whip, sour cream, and dill weed; mix well.
Coarsely chop radishes and finely chop onion using food chopper.
Grate carrot using grater.
Stir radishes, onion, and carrot into mixture.
Chill and serve.

appetizers-friendship-tea-spiced-tea.title: Friendship Tea (Spiced Tea)

items: 1 cup sugar (I don't use the sugar)

directions: Mix all ingredients and store in air-tight container.
Place about 1 1/2 Tbsp. mix per 1 cup of boiling liquid (H2O).
notes: Sugar is optional: "I don't use the sugar."

appetizers-fruit-dip.title: Fruit Dip
directions: Blend marshmallow cream and cream cheese.
Chill and serve with fruit.

appetizers-garden-vegetable-dip.title: Garden Vegetable Dip

items: 1 envelope Good Seasons Italian Salad Dressing Mix

directions: Place cottage cheese in blender or food processor, cover. Blend on low speed until pureed.
Stir in remaining ingredients. Refrigerate.
Serve with assorted cut-up vegetables. Garnish as desired.
notes: Makes 4 cups.

appetizers-hot-chocolate.title: Hot Chocolate
directions: Mix all ingredients thoroughly.
Use 1/3 cup mix for a mug of hot H2O.
Use 1/4 cup mix for a cup of hot H2O.

appetizers-oyster-cracker-snacks.title: Oyster Cracker Snacks
directions: Toss crackers with heated oil.
Blend all dry ingredients and sprinkle over oiled crackers.
Let sit for 24 hours, then store in a container.

appetizers-pizza-rounds.title: Pizza Rounds
directions: Brown meat and drain.
Cut Velveeta into chunks and melt, stirring often.
Mix melted cheese with meat mixture, 1 tsp. oregano, and mozzarella.
Spread on party rye.
Bake at 400°F for about 10-15 minutes.
notes: May place in freezer container with waxed paper between layers. Store and use as needed.
uncertain: quantity of hot pork sausage: "2 pound" (could be "1/2 pound"; the line has an extra mark before the 2)

appetizers-rainbow-punch.title: Rainbow Punch

items: Large jug of red Hawaiian Punch
1 container of frozen sherbet (raspberry, pineapple, lime)

directions: Mix ginger ale and Hawaiian Punch.
Add 1 container of frozen sherbet (raspberry, pineapple, lime).

appetizers-shrimp-spread.title: Shrimp Spread

items: 1 can baby shrimp - cleaned and chopped

directions: Cream cheese with lemon juice.
Add onion, shrimp, Worcestershire, salt and pepper.
Chill and spread on crackers.

appetizers-spinach-dip.title: Spinach Dip

items: 1 pkg. frozen chopped spinach (thawed and drained)

directions: Mix and chill.

appetizers-stuffed-mushrooms.title: Stuffed Mushrooms

items: 5 slices of white bread (crusts removed) cubed

directions: After cleaning mushrooms carefully, remove stems and place in food processor - chop finely.
Next, chop onion finely.
Then melt margarine in a large skillet over medium heat. Add mushrooms and onion. Saute until tender.
Then add bread cubes, and mix until moisture is absorbed.
Finally, add about 12 oz of mozzarella cheese and mix.
Stuff mushrooms and top with mozzarella.
Bake for 20 minutes in Pyrex baking dish (dotted with margarine slices) at 350°F.
Then broil for 3 minutes to brown.

appetizers-taco-dip.title: Taco Dip
directions: Blend cream cheese, Miracle Whip, sour cream, and Avocado Dip.
Add a dash of Worcestershire sauce and mix well.
Spread mixture on a large plate.
Top with chopped onion, lettuce (shredded), tomatoes, and shredded cheese.
Cover, chill and serve with tortilla chips.

appetizers-the-wallaby-darned.title: The Wallaby Darned

items: 1/2 cup Bacardi frozen fuzzy navel mix

directions: Combine all ingredients in a blender.
Blend on high for 30 seconds or until ice is completely crushed and the drink is smooth.
uncertain: brand of fuzzy navel mix: written like "Racard.", read as "Bacardi"

breads-apricot-bread.title: Apricot Bread
directions: Cream together butter and sugar.
Add egg, water, and orange juice.
Then add sifted dry ingredients (flour, baking powder, soda, and salt).
Lastly, fold in apricots and nuts, and pour into a greased, floured bread pan.
Bake for about 1 hour at 350°F.

breads-banana-blueberry-bread.title: Banana-Blueberry Bread
directions: Cream butter and sugar thoroughly.
Add 2 eggs, 1 tsp. vanilla, and 5-6 mashed bananas.
Mix in 2 cups flour, 1/4 tsp. salt, and 1 tsp. baking soda.
Finally, add 1 1/2 - 2 cups fresh or frozen blueberries.
Pour into 4 small, greased/floured bread pans.
Bake at 325°F-350°F for 1 hour.

breads-banana-cake-muffins.title: Banana Cake/Muffins
directions: Keep sugar separate.
In separate dish add milk.
In separate dish add slightly beaten egg.
In separate dish add dry, sifted ingredients (salt, soda, flour).
In separate dish add 5 bananas.
Muffins: Mash bananas with potato masher. Set aside.
Muffins: Spray Pam in muffin pan.
Muffins: Cream together sugar and Crisco until fluffy.
Muffins: Add 2 Tbsp of milk, then eggs to creamed mixture.
Muffins: Alternately add dried ingredients and milk and beat until mixed.
Muffins: Bake 350°F for about 30 mins.
Cake: Cut out parchment paper and line the bottom of 3 8 or 9 inch cake pans.
Cake: Add mixture. Bake 350°F for about 30 mins.
uncertain: where the mashed bananas are added is not written; the cook's line reads "In separate dish add 5 bananas"

breads-christmas-fruit-bread.title: Christmas Fruit Bread

items: yeast (1 cake fresh or 1 pkg. yeast)
1 cup chopped candied fruit (red and green cherries, pineapple)

directions: Combine milk, 1 Tbsp. sugar and salt; cool to lukewarm.
Add yeast that has been softened in lukewarm water.
Add 3 cups flour; beat thoroughly. Let rise until light and bubbly.
Thoroughly cream shortening and sugar. Add lemon peel, vanilla, nutmeg, and eggs.
Stir into sponge mixture.
Add remaining ingredients; mix to make smooth, soft dough. Let rest 10 minutes.
Knead on lightly floured surface until smooth and elastic.
Place in greased bowl; cover with a damp cloth and let rise until double.
Punch down. Shape loaves. Let rise until double.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°F.

breads-cinnamon-rolls.title: Cinnamon Rolls
directions: Dissolve yeast with 1/4 cup warm water; let stand for 10 minutes.
Mix Bisquick with 1/2 cup water; add to yeast. Dough should be soft, but not gooey.
Divide dough into fourths and roll each into a rectangular shape about 1/4" thick.
Brush with melted butter.
Mix together sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over butter.
Roll in jellyroll fashion. Cut into 1" slices and place into greased pans (either muffin pans or 8" cake pans).
Brush top with remaining butter and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.
Bake at 350°F for 20 minutes.

breads-coffee-cake.title: Coffee Cake
directions: Scald 1 cup canned Milnot and fill Milnot can with water.
Place 1 stick margarine, 1/2 cup sugar and 1 tsp. salt in large bowl; pour hot milk over it. Let cool.
Add 1 tsp. vanilla and 2 beaten eggs.
Dissolve 1 pkg. yeast and 1/2 tsp. sugar in 1/4 cup lukewarm water.
Add 2 cups flour, then set aside to get bubbly.
Beat and add flour 1 cup at a time. Then finish adding flour with a spoon - using a total of about 5 cups flour.
Place on a floured bread board and knead until dough doesn't stick to hands. (Fold top down, rotate dough and knead.)
Place in greased bowl to rise and cover with a damp dish towel. (Make sure you flip dough so that both sides are greased.)
Punch down 2-3 times.
Brush with butter and sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon.
Bake at 350°F for 25-30 minutes.

breads-corn-bread.title: Corn Bread
directions: Melt 1 stick of butter in a 9"x12" pan in the oven. Let cool in pan.
Sift together 2 cups flour, 1 cup sugar, 5 tsp. baking powder, and 1 tsp. salt. Add 1 cup yellow cornmeal.
Beat 2 eggs and stir in 2 cups milk. Add to flour.
Lastly, pour in melted butter from pan. Mix well.
Pour entire mixture back into 9"x12" pan and bake for 25 minutes at 400°F.

breads-cracked-wheat-bread.title: Cracked Wheat Bread

items: 5 - 5 1/2 cup flour (we use 1 cup whole wheat, 4 1/2 unbleached flour and 2 Tbsp. wheat germ)

directions: Combine boiling water, cracked wheat, brown sugar, butter, and salt; cool until warm.
Meanwhile, soften yeast in warm water and combine with above.
Beat in as much flour as you can, then knead in the rest. Knead 8-10 min.
Let rise 1 1/2 hrs. Punch down, divide in two, let rest 10 min.
Roll each piece into a 12x16 shape, then roll up jelly-roll style into a 12" loaf.
Pinch ends and tuck under. Let rise 1 hr. on a greased cookie sheet.
Bake 375°F for 30 min.
notes: This is so yummy fresh out of the oven, or later when cooled and the next morning as toast!
A Great Summer Sandwich: assemble as follows - sliced cracked wheat bread, thinly sliced rare roast beef, garden fresh sliced tomatoes, dollop of homemade mayo and topped with dill weed.

breads-cranberry-bread.title: Cranberry Bread

items: juice of one orange plus grated orange rind (add water to orange juice to make 3/4 cup), boil

directions: Sift dry ingredients, and add orange juice, rind, water liquid.
Add egg and butter and beat well.
Add raw cranberries and nuts by hand.
Bake in greased loaf pan for one hour at 350°F.
Let stand for 24 hours before cutting.

breads-fruit-cake-confections.title: Fruit Cake Confections
breads-fruit-cake-confections.serves: 3 dozen muffin size or 5 dozen cupcake size
directions: Thoroughly cream butter, and add sugar and molasses, beating until well-mixed.
Add eggs one at a time and beat until light and fluffy.
Sift flour with soda and spices. Stir in by hand.
Add the vanilla.
Make sure all fruit is soft. (If dry, steam over boiling water for a few minutes; cool.)
Stir in the fruit and blend mixture thoroughly.
Line small muffin or cupcake pans with colored foil baking cups. Spoon batter evenly in cups, filling them 3/4 full.
Bake at 325°F for about 50-60 minutes for muffin size, and 45 minutes for cupcake size. If cakes brown too quickly, cover loosely with a sheet of foil.
Leave cakes in foil cups and cool thoroughly.
Sprinkle with brandy or sherry. Keep tightly covered.

breads-gooey-butter-coffee-cake.title: Gooey Butter Coffee Cake

items: 1 box Duncan Hines Yellow Cake Mix

directions: Mix cake mix, melted butter, and eggs.
Spread above ingredients in greased and floured 9"x12" pan.
Mix together cream cheese, powdered sugar, and eggs. Spread over bottom layer.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar and bake for 40-50 minutes at 350°F.

breads-grandmas-icing.title: Grandma's Icing
directions: Mix by hand.
Add small amounts of water at a time until it is creamy.
Then beat with mixer until very creamy.

breads-honey-mustard.title: Honey Mustard
directions: Mix mayo, sour cream & mustard with wire whisk.
Add honey, lemon juice, salt & pepper, stirring until well combined.

breads-lemonberry-poppyseed-bread.title: Lemonberry Poppyseed Bread

items: 1 box Bakery Style Blueberry Muffin Mix
Blueberries and raspberries to taste (about 3/4 cup of each)

directions: Mix above ingredients until smooth.
Add blueberries and raspberries to your particular taste (I use about 3/4 cup of each).
Before baking, add crumb topping over mixture.
Bake in 3 greased/floured small bread pans at 350°F for 50-60 minutes.
Cool on cooling racks and top with glaze made from 1/2 cup powdered sugar, 1 Tbsp. lemon juice, and 1 Tbsp. lemon zest.
notes: Before baking, add crumb topping over mixture.

breads-nut-bread.title: Nut Bread
directions: Beat eggs and sugar together.
Add milk, then remaining ingredients.
Bake in greased/floured loaf pans at 325°F for 45-50 minutes.

breads-pumpkin-bread.title: Pumpkin Bread
directions: Mix sugar & shortening.
Beat in eggs.
Add remaining ingredients and mix well.
Place mixture into 3 greased & floured loaf pans.
Bake for 45-50 minutes at 350°F.

breads-strawberry-jam-freezer-2.title: Strawberry Jam (cont.)

items: Prepared fruit: 3 cups mashed peaches, 2 Tbsp. fresh lemon juice

directions: Strawberry Jam: Pour into prepared containers, leaving 1/2 inch space at top for expansion during freezing; cover.
Strawberry Jam: Let stand at room temp. 24 hours until set.
Strawberry Jam: If not set after 24 hours, refrigerate for up to 3 weeks. Otherwise, store in freezer for up to 1 yr. Thaw in refrigerator.
Peach Jam: Same instructions as Strawberry Jam except fruit.
notes: Continuation of Freezer Strawberry Jam (steps 8-9) from page 36.

breads-strawberry-jam-freezer.title: Freezer Strawberry Jam
directions: Wash & rinse plastic containers with tight fitting lids. Use 1 to 2 cup size containers.

Prepare fruit. (Discard stems & crush strawberries.) For berries, crush 1 cup at a time, using a potato masher for best results. If using food processor, pulse to very finely chop. Do not puree. Jam should have bits of fruit.
Measure exact amount of prepared fruit (2 cups) into a large bowl.
Measure exact amount of sugar into separate bowl. (Do not reduce sugar; do not use sugar substitutes.)
Stir sugar into prepared fruit. Mix well. Let stand 10 min. Stir occasionally.
Stir pectin & 3/4 cup water in small saucepan. (Pectin may start lumpy.) Bring to boil on high heat, stirring constantly. Remove from heat.
Stir pectin mixture into fruit mixture. Stir constantly until sugar is completely dissolved & no longer grainy, about three min. (A few sugar crystals may remain.)
notes: Continued on next page (steps 8-9 and Peach Jam variation on page 37).

breads-strawberry-tea.title: Strawberry Tea Bread
directions: Beat eggs well, add sugar & mix.
Add butter & mashed strawberries.
Add mixture to sifted dry ingredients; mix.
Pour into 2 greased loaf pans and bake about 1 hour at 350°F.
Cool in pan for about 10 minutes.

cakes-apple-upside-down-cake-2.title: Apple Upside-Down Cake (cont.)
directions: If some of the apple topping sticks to the pan, just put the apples back where they belong & spread the sugary caramel on top with a small spatula.
Serve warm or at room temp., garnished with whipped topping or apple slices, if desired.
notes: Nutrition: 241 calories, 40g carb., 8g fat, 8g protein, 4g fiber.

cakes-apple-upside-down-cake.title: Apple Upside-Down Cake

items: 2 cup thinly sliced Golden Delicious or Cortland apples

directions: Preheat oven 350°F.
Melt 1 T of margarine in a 9 x 1 1/2 inch round cake pan over very low heat. Remove from heat.
Sprinkle margarine with brown sugar & arrange apple slices in overlapping pattern on top.
Sift together flour & baking powder.
Beat remaining 4 T margarine with sugar, egg, orange rind & vanilla at medium speed until smooth & creamy.
Add the flour mixture alternately with the milk, beating until evenly blended.
Pour batter over apples & spread evenly.
Bake 40 min., or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool in pan on wire rack 5 min.
With a butter knife or a narrow metal spatula, loosen cake from sides of pan. Invert onto a plate.

cakes-carrot-cake.title: Carrot Cake
directions: Cake: Combine sugar, oil, & eggs; mix.
Cake: Add remaining dry ingredients and mix.
Cake: Finally, add carrots and nuts and mix.
Cake: Pour into greased jelly roll pan (9x12) and bake at 300°F for 1 1/2 hours.
Icing: Mix powdered sugar and cream cheese and spread.

cakes-chocolate-pudding-cake.title: Chocolate Pudding Cake
directions: Melt chocolate, sugar, and water in double boiler.
Beat 4 egg yolks. Add to above ingredients.
Soften 1 envelope Knox gelatin in 2 Tbsp. water and add to above ingredients; cool all ingredients.
Add 1/2 pint whipped cream and 4 egg whites stiffly beaten. Fold into cooled mixture.
Next, tear a large angel food cake into small pieces. Place in a 9"x11" cake pan.
Alternate layers - cake, pudding, cake, pudding.
May place crushed nuts on top if desired.
Refrigerate.

cakes-date-nut-bars.title: Date Nut Bars
directions: Beat sugar & eggs.
Add other ingredients.
Bake in greased 8"x10" pan for 45 min - 1 hr. at 3[?]5°F.
After baking, sprinkle with powdered sugar & cut into squares.

cakes-dirt-cake.title: Dirt Cake
directions: Crush Oreos in food processor.
Mix other ingredients.
Line bottom of flower pot with foil.
Layer cookies, pudding, etc., making sure to end with cookie crumbs.
Place a silk flower in pot, and place gummie worms as though they are coming out of dirt onto the side of the pot.
notes: Makes a nice centerpiece.

cakes-key-lime-cake.title: Key Lime Cake

items: 1 box Duncan Hines Lemon Supreme Cake Mix

directions: Cake: Combine ingredients and beat 2 minutes at medium speed with electric mixer.
Cake: Pour batter into greased 13x9x2 pan.
Cake: Bake at 350°F for 35 minutes or until toothpick comes clean.
Cake: Let pan cool on wire rack.
Icing: Combine powdered sugar and key lime juice. Drizzle or spread over cake.

cakes-lemon-angel-cake.title: Lemon Angel Cake
directions: Prepare angel food cake according to directions, and pour batter into 9"x13" pan, spreading evenly over bottom.
Bake on center rack for about 35-40 min. or until crust is golden brown and cracked.
Turn cake upside down and cool on cooling rack.
When cool, poke holes in cake about 1 1/2" deep and 1/2" apart with fork.
Zest 1 Tbsp. lemon zest, and squeeze lemons to yield 1/4 cup lemon juice.
Whisk together lemon juice & zest, and powdered sugar.
Pour glaze over cake and let stand 30 min.
To serve, garnish each slice with Cool Whip and raspberries.

cakes-lemon-cake-and-glaze.title: Lemon Cake & Glaze
directions: Cake: Follow directions on cake box & add lemon pudding; mix and follow baking directions on box.
Cake: While hot, poke holes in cake & pour topping over cake.
Glaze: Mix and pour over warm lemon cake. (Use a fork & stick holes in lemon cake.)

cakes-red-velvet-cake.title: Red Velvet Cake

items: 2 - 1 oz bottles red food coloring, or 1 & 1 bottle H2O

directions: Mix coloring & cocoa together in small bowl.
Cream Crisco & sugar.
Add eggs & coloring & beat well.
Add buttermilk, vanilla, salt & flour. Beat well with mixer.
Mix soda & vinegar together, then add to mixture & beat hard.
Bake in 2 layers. Bake 30 min @ 350°F.

directions: 1st Part: Place flour in saucepan & gradually add milk.

cakes-turtle-cake.title: Turtle Cake
directions: Mix cake according to package directions.
Pour 1/2 of batter into 13" by 9" greased pan and bake 15 minutes at 350°F.
Meanwhile melt caramels in a double boiler; when melted add butter & milk.
Stir caramel mixture well and pour over baked cake.
Pour chocolate chips over caramel mixture and top with remaining batter.
Return pan to oven and bake for another 15 minutes.

cakes-wacky-cake.title: Wacky Cake
directions: Cake: Sift flour, sugar, cocoa, salt and soda together in a baking pan.
Cake: Make 3 holes & add vanilla, vinegar and cooking oil.
Cake: Cover with 1 cup cold water & mix thoroughly with a fork.
Cake: Bake @ 350°F for [?] min.
Icing: Melt butter & chocolate together; add to powdered sugar.
Icing: Add milk & vanilla and mix.

desserts-apple-crunch-pudding.title: Apple Crunch Pudding
directions: Mix sugar, flour, & spices together, and stir in cornflakes.
Next, add melted butter.
Place half mixture into a shallow baking dish, top with apples, cover with remaining mixture, and top with nuts.
Bake at 350°F for 25 minutes.

desserts-apple-dumplings.title: Apple Dumplings

items: Jonathan apples, peeled, cored, and sliced 1/2" thick

directions: Dumplings: Mix like you would biscuit dough.
Dumplings: Roll out - cover dough with Jonathan apples that have been peeled, cored, and sliced 1/2" thick.
Dumplings: Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon over apples and roll up jellyroll style.
Dumplings: Pour syrup over roll and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.
Syrup: Mix together and boil for 3 minutes.

desserts-applesauce.title: Applesauce
directions: Peel, quarter, and core apples.
Place in saucepan with about 1 inch of water in pan.
Cook covered over medium heat.
Cook until apples are almost liquid (may need to add a little more water depending upon apples).
Add enough sugar or Equal to suit you.
Chill.

desserts-boiled-custard.title: Boiled Custard
directions: Beat eggs until well-beaten and add to milk & sugar; place in a large pan.
Place this pan into a larger pan containing water (water should go 1/2 way up the outside of the pan).
Cook over medium heat for 1 hour, stirring 3-4 times.
When cool, add 2 tsp. vanilla.
Strain and chill in a large container.

desserts-homemade-ice-cream.title: Homemade Ice Cream
directions: Thoroughly mix eggs and sugar - about 10 minutes.
Add whipping cream and mix another 5-10 minutes.
Place mixture in ice cream freezer, and add milk and vanilla (it takes a lot of vanilla).
Finish ice cream according to freezer directions.

desserts-peanut-roll.title: Peanut Roll

items: hot water until very, very thin

directions: Sponge Cake: Beat for 10 minutes.
Sponge Cake: Bake for about 30 minutes. Put in 9"x12" pan in a 275°F oven and then gradually increase oven temp to 350°F.
Sponge Cake: Cool, and cut in squares.
Ice and roll in crushed peanuts.
notes: No flour is listed for the sponge cake on the page.

desserts-rice-pudding.title: Rice Pudding
directions: Combine rice, water, & salt. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover, & cook about 9 minutes.
Stir in 2 1/4 cup milk, cover, & cook over low heat for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.
(Meanwhile, cover raisins with boiling water and set aside.)
Add butter to hot pudding mixture, stirring constantly.
Cook about 5 minutes or until mixture thickens.
Combine eggs, sugar, and remaining milk and add to pudding mixture.
Remove from heat, add drained raisins & vanilla.
Chill.

desserts-turtle-cheesecake.title: Turtle Cheesecake
directions: Cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla with electric mixer until well blended.
Add eggs and mix until well blended; set aside.
Melt caramels with milk on low heat, stirring frequently until smooth.
Stir in pecans.
Pour caramel and pecan mixture into graham cracker crust.
Top with cheese batter.
Bake at 350°F for about 40 minutes or until knife comes out of center clean.
Chill at least 3 hours.

eggs-cheese-baked-eggs.title: Baked Eggs
directions: Spread cubed bread evenly on bottom of 9"x13" greased Pyrex dish.
Melt Velveeta and butter together and pour over bread.
Blend eggs and milk together and pour over first 2 ingredients.
Refrigerate overnight.
Cook (bake) at 350°F for 1 hour - 1 hour 15 minutes.

eggs-cheese-deviled-eggs.title: Deviled Eggs
directions: Place 6 eggs in a medium sauce pan and cover with water.
Bring to a boil and continue boiling for 15 minutes.
Immediately cover eggs with cold water and remove shells.
Next cut eggs into halves and place yolks into a bowl.
Then mash yolks, add enough pickle juice to make yolks moist and smooth.
Add about 1 Tbsp. sugar, a dash of salt and pepper and Miracle Whip (enough to make egg mixture creamy).
Stuff eggs.

eggs-cheese-mariachis.title: Mariachis

items: 3-4 Idaho potatoes boiled (about 20 minutes) and grated
margarine (enough to cover the bottom of the skillet)

directions: Melt margarine in skillet, add beaten eggs, crumbled bacon, and scramble.
Next, boil 3-4 Idaho potatoes (about 20 minutes) and grate.
Use enough margarine to cover the bottom of the skillet, and fry the potatoes.
Shred 1/2 pound colby cheese.
Place eggs on tortillas, cover with fried potatoes, add shredded cheese, and top with salsa.

eggs-cheese-quiche.title: Quiche

items: 1 sweet onion diced and sauteed in butter
2 1/2 cup half & half (beaten thoroughly with eggs)

directions: Place crust in 9" pie pan.
Place sauteed onions over crust.
Next, place crumbled bacon over crust.
Then place shredded cheese over bacon.
Finally, pour eggs & half & half mixture over cheese.
Bake at 350°F for about 1 hour.
Quiche is done when knife is placed in center of quiche and it comes out clean.
Let sit for about 10 minutes until serving.

meats-beef-and-cabbage.title: Beef and Cabbage
directions: Place meat and onion into a large pot, and add about 1/2 pot of water.
Cook over medium heat about 1 1/2 hours to 2 hours, or until tender.
When meat is tender, add cabbage wedges and potatoes.
Continue cooking another 1 1/2 hours over medium heat.

meats-chicken-stir-fry.title: Chicken Stir Fry
directions: Clean chicken, and cut into bite-size pieces.
In large frying pan, spread 1 Tbsp. of oil and saute sliced chicken.
Add 1 Tbsp. of soy sauce, 1 Tbsp. butter, and a dash of salt and pepper.
When the chicken appears white on all sides, add 2 tsp. lemon juice, and push chicken to 1 side of the pan.
Add mushrooms to the other side of the pan, pour 1 Tbsp. soy sauce over the mushroom, then add 1 Tbsp. butter.
After 8-10 minutes, sprinkle 1 tsp. of sesame seeds over the chicken.

meats-chop-suey.title: Chop Suey

items: Bead molasses (Brown Gravy Sauce) - add until color is dark as desired

directions: Place meat in dutch oven and sear over low heat.
Add onion and celery and cook until meat draws its own juices.
Add bean sprouts and mushrooms.
Cover mixture with water, add salt, pepper, and bead molasses.
Cook slowly, adding water as necessary for about 5 hours.
Thicken with cornstarch before serving.
Serve over steamed white rice.

meats-emmys-hamburger.title: Emmy's Hamburger
directions: Mix all of the above ingredients together.
Slice a loaf of French Bread lengthwise.
Spread above mixture onto sliced bread.
Bake on a cookie sheet at 350°F for 40-45 minutes.
Top with Velveeta Cheese and continue baking until cheese melts.

meats-flank-steak.title: Flank Steak
directions: Marinate Flank Steak in the soy sauce, ginger, brown sugar, worcestershire sauce, salt, and water.
Marinate at least 8 hours.
Broil or grill on each side for about 6 minutes.

meats-french-dipped-sandwich.title: French Dipped Sandwich
directions: Place sirloin tip roast in large roaster pan (uncovered) in 400°F oven for 1 hour.
Turn roast, apply salt, pepper, & garlic powder, cover, reduce heat to 325°F and cook for several hours. [Reserve meat drippings.]
After roast cools, trim fat off it and slice.
To meat drippings, add 2 packages of McCormick's Au Jus (prepared according to package directions).
Heat thoroughly and add sliced meat.
To serve, place meat on Chicago Rolls, and place juice in small individual bowls.

meats-goulash.title: Goulash
directions: Brown sirloin with onion and drain off excess fat.
Add tomatoes and tomato sauce.
Add about 2 cups of water, salt and pepper, and simmer about 30 minutes.
Next, add 1 1/4 cup cooked macaroni, and cook another 30 minutes.
You may need to add more water and salt and pepper.
Top with Parmesan Cheese and serve.

meats-hamburger-casserole.title: Hamburger Casserole
directions: Layer the following ingredients in greased 2 qt. casserole: thinly sliced potatoes, peas, chopped celery, chopped carrots, chopped onions.
Place browned meat on top.
Empty can of tomato juice into a bowl.
Place pea juice into soup can and fill the can the rest of the way with water.
Mix juice with soup and pour over the top of the meat.
Bake at 350°F for 1 1/2 hours. Cover for the first hour, then uncover.
uncertain: "Empty can of tomato juice into a bowl" - the word read as "juice" may be "soup" (later steps refer to a soup can)

meats-macs-sloppy-joes.title: Mac's Sloppy Joes
directions: Brown ground sirloin in deep skillet, drain off excess fat, and set aside.
Combine remaining ingredients except cornstarch and water.
Simmer the mixture for 1/2 hour.
Make a paste with the cornstarch and water, and add to the simmering mixture, cooking about 10 minutes longer to thicken.
Lastly, add the browned sirloin and cook another 10 minutes.
Serve on buns.

meats-meatloaf.title: Meatloaf
directions: Place sirloin in a bowl, add onion, egg, and salt & pepper. Mix.
Add cornflakes, and enough milk to make meatloaf the right consistency.
Shape into a loaf, and place in loaf pan (put enough water in pan to cover the bottom of the pan).
If desired, place 1 piece of bacon on top to flavor, or you may cover the top with catsup.
Bake about 1 hour at 350°F.

meats-pizza-spaghetti-pie.title: Pizza Spaghetti Pie
directions: Meat Layer: Mix ground sirloin, bread crumbs, onion, salt, pepper, and evaporated milk. Bake at 350°F for 35-40 minutes.
Spaghetti Layer: Mix cooked spaghetti, beaten egg, grated parmesan, and butter, and put on meat layer.
Topping: Add 8 oz spaghetti sauce to spaghetti layer, 1 cup shredded mozzarella & sprinkle [?] parmesan.
Bake for 10 minutes.
Let stand for 5 minutes before cutting.

"2 T butter" - the "2" is hard to read
"& sprinkle [?] parmesan" - word(s) between "sprinkle" and "parmesan" unreadable (possibly "w/" or "with")

meats-shish-kabob.title: Shish-Kabob
directions: Mix all of the marinade ingredients.
Marinate sirloin sizzlers whole or cut into large chunks - marinate for 1-2 days. Also, add whole mushrooms.
To make kabobs, thread 3 pieces of meat, 1 square of bacon, mushroom, onion slice. Repeat until skewer is as full as desired.
Grill 15-20 minutes, brushing with sauce frequently.

meats-sloppy-joes.title: Sloppy Joes
directions: Brown ground sirloin with chopped onion - drain excess fat.
Add remaining ingredients and simmer approximately 1 hour.

meats-spaghetti-pie.title: Spaghetti Pie
directions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions; stir butter into drained, hot spaghetti.
Stir in Parmesan cheese and eggs.
Form spaghetti mixture into a crust in a buttered 10" pie pan.
Spread cottage cheese over the bottom of the spaghetti crust.
In skillet, cook ground sirloin, onion, and green pepper until vegetables are tender and the meat is brown. Drain off excess fat.
Stir in tomato sauce, and heat thoroughly.
Turn meat mixture into crust.
Bake uncovered at 350°F for 20 min.
Sprinkle mozzarella cheese over the pie and cook for an additional 5 minutes.

meats-stew.title: Stew

items: 2 pounds of either London Broil, or stew meat
3 Tbsp. flour and 1/2 cup water (for thickening)

directions: Flour and salt & pepper meat and place in small amount of canola oil in hot dutch oven.
Brown meat on both sides, and cover with sliced medium onion.
Cook over low heat for about 1 1/2 hours (covered), or until meat is tender.
Turn meat several times, and add water if meat does not draw its own juices.
When meat is tender, cut into bite-size pieces, scrape the bottom of the pan, and add enough water until pan is about 1/2 full.
Add 3 potatoes - diced, 2 carrots - chopped, 1 package frozen baby peas, and 1 cup sliced mushrooms.
Cook for about 30-45 minutes or until veggies are tender.
Before serving, thicken with a mixture of 3 Tbsp. flour and 1/2 cup water.

meats-stir-fry-beef.title: Stir Fry Beef
directions: Cut flank steak in bite-size pieces and place in a bowl with soy sauce, sherry, sugar, salt, and garlic - marinate about 2 hours.
Blanch broccoli about 1 minute - drain.
Heat oil, add beef, and cook for 5 minutes.
Dissolve bouillon cube in 1/4 cup water, and add 1 Tbsp. cornstarch - cook until thick.
Add thickened mixture to meat and cook about 1 minute.
Add veggies 1 at a time and cook until tender.
Serve over rice.

meats-stuffed-peppers.title: Stuffed Peppers

items: water - add enough so that the mixture is the right consistency

directions: Before stuffing peppers, soak them in salt water for 1-2 hours.
Stuff peppers with meat mixture, cover with sauce, and bake for 1 1/2 hrs. at 350°F.

meats-veal-scallopini.title: Veal Scallopini

items: 3/4 cup flour - mixed with 1 tsp. salt & 1/4 tsp. pepper

directions: Roll veal cubes in seasoned flour and fry in hot oil until well-browned.
Place in a crockpot.
Add all the remaining ingredients. Mix well.
Cover and cook on high for 1 hour, then reduce heat and cook for 6-8 hours on low.
Serve over fettucini.

miscellaneous-apricot-oatmeal-cookies.title: Apricot Oatmeal Cookies
directions: Chop apricots, cover with boiled water. Let stand 5 min. and drain.
Mix softened butter and add 1/2 of flour, brown sugar, sugar, eggs, baking powder, vanilla, cinnamon, & soda.
Beat until thoroughly mixed, stir in remaining ingredients.
Finally add oats, apricots & nuts.
Drop by tsp. onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake at 350°F about 10 min. or until edges are brown.
Place on wire rack to cool; drizzle with icing.
Icing: Mix powdered sugar and milk.

miscellaneous-asian-slaw.title: Asian Slaw

items: 2 (3 oz) packages beef-flavored ramen noodle soup mix
3/4 cup oil (1/2 of it is sesame oil)

directions: Remove flavor packets from soup mix, & set aside; crush noodles.
Place noodles in bottom of a large bowl.
Top with slaw mix; sprinkle with almonds, sunflower kernels, & green onions.
Whisk together contents from flavor packets, sugar, oil, & vinegar; pour over slaw.
Cover & chill 24 hours.
Toss before serving.

miscellaneous-caramel-oatmeal-chewies.title: Caramel Oatmeal Chewies
directions: Combine oats, flour, brown sugar, soda, & salt, and add margarine, mixing until mixture is crumbly (reserve 1 cup for topping).
Press remaining mixture into a greased 13x9" pan.
Bake at 350°F for 10 min.
Cool & top with nuts & chocolate pieces.
In small pan melt caramels & water over low heat. Stir until smooth, drizzle over choc. & nuts to within 1/4" of pan edges.
Sprinkle with reserved topping.
Bake 15-18 minutes until brown.
Chill until set, and cut into bars.
Store tightly covered.

miscellaneous-cherry-chip-cookies.title: Cherry Chip Cookies
directions: Cream butter & sugar until light and fluffy.
Mix in egg yolk and almond extract.
Add sifted flour & salt; mix.
Stir in cornflakes and cherry chips.
Roll into 1" balls, place on ungreased cookie sheets, press flat with fork lengthwise and crosswise and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake at 375°F for 10-12 min.
Cool on cooling rack.

miscellaneous-chocolate-chip-coconut-mac.title: Chocolate Chip Coconut Macaroons
directions: Bake at 350°F for 11 minutes on parchment paper.

miscellaneous-cinnamon-stars.title: Cinnamon Stars
directions: Beat eggs & sugar for 30 minutes.
Add 2 Tbsp. cinnamon, a pinch of salt, and peanuts.
Chill in refrig. overnight.
Roll out on powdered sugar board.
Cut in star shapes and bake on ungreased cookie sheets for 15 min. at 350°F.

miscellaneous-cornflake-macaroons.title: Cornflake Macaroons
directions: Whip egg whites until stiff, add 1 Tbsp. flour & whip 2-3 minutes longer.
Fold in sugar, add flavoring, cornflakes, & coconut.
Drop onto parchment covered cookie sheets by spoonfuls and bake at 350°F for 15-20 minutes.
Cool on wire rack.
notes: Use glass bowl or metal bowl, not plastic or rubber bowl.

miscellaneous-cranberry-quick-cookies.title: Cranberry Quick Cookies

items: 1 pkg. Pillsbury Cranberry Orange Bread Mix

directions: Heat oven to 350°F.
In large bowl, combine bread mix, oats, cranberries, coconut, and orange peel; mix well.
Add oil, water, and eggs; mix well.
Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls 2" apart onto ungreased cookie sheets.
Bake at 350°F for 10-13 minutes or until bottoms are golden brown.

miscellaneous-ginger-snaps.title: Ginger Snaps
directions: Sift together all dry ingredients and set aside.
Cream shortening and add sugar, egg, and molasses. Beat well.
Add dry ingredients and beat mixture until smooth (mixture will be stiff).
Form mixture into 1" balls, roll in sugar, and bake on greased cookie sheets at 350°F for 10-12 minutes.

miscellaneous-peanut-butter-bread.title: Peanut Butter Bread

items: 3/4 cup creamy or crunchy peanut butter

directions: Stir together first four ingredients in a medium bowl.
Cut in peanut butter with fork or pastry blender until crumbly.
Stir together egg and milk; stir into dry ingredients just until moistened.
Pour batter into a greased 9x5 loaf pan.
Bake at 350°F for 1 hour or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean.
Remove pan immediately, and cool on a wire rack.

miscellaneous-polka-dot-cookies.title: Polka Dot Cookies
directions: Cream butter and sugars, and add egg and vanilla; mix.
Sift together flour, baking powder, salt, and baking soda; add alternately with milk, mixing well after each addition.
Stir in chocolate chips, cherries and nuts.
Place rounded teaspoons of dough on greased cookie sheets.
Bake at 375°F for 10-12 minutes.

miscellaneous-snickerdoodles.title: Snickerdoodles
directions: Mix shortening, sugar, and eggs thoroughly.
Blend flour, cream of tartar, soda, and salt. Stir into shortening mixture.
Shape dough into 1" balls. Roll in mixture of 2 Tbsp. sugar and cinnamon.
Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet.
Bake 8-10 min. at 400°F.

pasta-grains-campbells-chicken-and-brocc.title: Campbell's Chicken & Broccoli Alfredo

items: 1 can 10 3/4 oz Cream of Mushroom 98% fat free soup

directions: Cook pasta according to package directions. Add broccoli for last 4 minutes of cooking time. Drain.
Heat butter or olive oil in skillet. Add chicken and cook until browned, stirring often.
Add soup, milk, cheese, pepper and pasta. Heat through.
Add additional Parmesan cheese and serve.

pasta-grains-chicken-and-dumplings.title: Chicken and Dumplings
directions: Cook chicken as directed for chicken and noodles. Place chicken (cut-up) in a separate bowl.
Place 2 1/2 cups chicken broth (lightly salted) in a 9x13 Pyrex baking dish. Microwave 6-8 minutes on high power or until liquid bubbles.
Then add: drop dumplings by spoonful onto boiling liquid.
Dumplings: Place flour, baking powder, and salt in mixing bowl. Cut in shortening until mixture looks like cornmeal. Add milk and stir until mixture is moist.
Microwave uncovered for 6 minutes on High.
Cover and microwave on High for 5 minutes.

pasta-grains-chicken-and-noodles.title: Chicken & Noodles
directions: Place chicken breasts, onion, and salt & pepper in a stock pot. Fill the pot half-full of water and cook for about 1 1/2 hours. When the chicken falls away from the bone, the breasts are done.
Take chicken from the bone, cut in bite-sized pieces, and return to the broth.
You may need to add a little water (you need about 1/2 pot).
When the liquid begins to boil, add the noodles and cook for about 10-15 minutes or until they are tender.

pasta-grains-chicken-rice-casserole.title: Chicken Rice Casserole
directions: Cook chicken as directed for chicken and noodles.
Place 1 1/2 cups Uncle Ben's Rice in large greased casserole. Add 3 cups of chicken broth, and mix rice and broth together.
Cover and cook on high in microwave for 6 minutes. Then cook rice on Cook Power 5 for about 12 minutes.
Then add 2 cans of cream of mushroom soup, 16 oz sliced mushrooms, chicken, and enough broth to make mixture moist.
Cook for 1 hour at 350°F.
Gravy: Place flour in saucepan and gradually add chicken broth. Cook over low heat until thickened. Serve over casserole if desired.

pasta-grains-homemade-noodles.title: Homemade Noodles

items: 1 cup flour (or enough to make dough stiff)
several drops of yellow food coloring

directions: Homemade Noodles: Roll very thin on a floured surface; let stand 20 minutes.
Homemade Noodles: Roll up loosely; let slices be 1/4" wide, unroll, spread out and let dry about 2 hours. (If desired you may store the noodles in an airtight container in the freezer until needed.)
Beef and Noodles: Flour and salt and pepper meat. Brown in a small amount of oil (use dutch oven).

Beef and Noodles: Reduce heat, cover with a sliced onion, and simmer for about 2 hours or until meat is tender. (Keep checking because you may need to add water if the meat doesn't draw its own juices.)
Beef and Noodles: When meat is tender, remove from broth, cut in bite-sized pieces and return to broth.
Beef and Noodles: Add water to about half of dutch oven, cook uncovered. When liquid bubbles, drop in noodles and cook uncovered for about 10-15 minutes.

pasta-grains-italian-pasta-stir-fry.title: Italian Pasta Stir Fry
directions: Cook linguine according to package directions, drain and keep warm.
Slice zucchini, and snip parsley.
Heat oil in stir-fry skillet until hot, and press garlic into skillet; stir-fry about 15 seconds.
Add zucchini and onion and stir-fry 2-3 minutes until vegetables are crisp-tender.
Add tomatoes, parsley, and seasonings; heat for 1-2 minutes stirring gently.
Remove from heat and stir in warm linguine.
Top with grated Parmesan cheese.

pasta-grains-japanese-fried-rice.title: Japanese Fried Rice
directions: Cook the rice according to directions, and add vegetables.
Melt butter in a large frying pan over medium/high heat, add rice mixture, soy sauce, and salt & pepper.
Cook 6-8 minutes stirring frequently.

pasta-grains-lasagna.title: Lasagna
directions: In a skillet brown ground sirloin with onion and garlic; drain grease off meat.
Add chopped tomatoes, tomato paste, pepper, and salt. Simmer about 1 hour.
In a large bowl, mix ricotta cheese and eggs.
In a 9"x13" lasagna pan place a layer of lasagna noodles on the bottom, top with 1/2 of sauce, then 1/2 of ricotta mixture, 3/4 lb. mozzarella, Parmesan cheese.
Repeat above mixture for the next layer.
Bake about 1 hour at 350°F.
uncertain: Parmesan cheese is used in the directions but has no quantity in the ingredient list (not on the page)

pasta-grains-macaroni-and-cheese.title: Macaroni & Cheese
directions: Place macaroni in boiling salted water in a medium saucepan. Cook only 3-4 minutes (macaroni should be slightly hard; if you cook too long it won't absorb the milk).
Divide macaroni into halves. Place 1/2 into 8"x10" greased casserole, and salt and pepper. Cover generously with grated cheese.
Place next layer of macaroni onto cheese and apply salt & pepper. Top with remainder of cheese. Dot with margarine slices.
Add milk until it comes up to the top of cheese (but don't cover the cheese).
Bake at 350°F for about 1 hour.

pasta-grains-pasta-salad.title: Pasta Salad
directions: Add Salad Supreme to cooked spaghetti, and mix.
Then add Italian Dressing and mix.
Next, add chopped vegetables and mix.
Cover and refrigerate.

pasta-grains-rice-casserole.title: Rice Casserole
directions: Mix all ingredients together and place in a large greased casserole.
Bake covered for 45 minutes at 350°F.
Uncover and cook for 15 minutes longer.

pasta-grains-spaghetti-sauce.title: Spaghetti Sauce

items: 2 medium Vidalia or sweet onions, chopped with food processor
1 bunch of garlic, chopped with food processor

directions: Sauce: Place a heated dutch oven (large pan) on stove. Place 2-3 Tbsp. olive oil in pan, and fold in chopped onion and garlic.
Sauce: Saute until onion is clear or transparent (not brown).
Sauce: Add 2 - 28 oz cans and 1 - 15 oz cans whole tomatoes (place tomatoes in food processor first).
Sauce: Then add 2 - 12 oz cans tomato paste.
Sauce: Next, pour about 3-4 cups of hot water into empty tomato paste cans, scraping sides. Add all water to sauce.
Sauce: Then add 2 Tbsp. sugar, 2 tsp. salt, and 1 tsp. pepper. Cook over low heat several hours (uncovered).
Meatballs: Mix well, form into balls, brown evenly in olive oil.
Meatballs: Simmer in sauce.

pasta-grains-spanish-beef-rice.title: Spanish Beef Rice
directions: Heat oil in a skillet, and add onion, peppers, beef, and rice.
Stir over medium high heat until lightly browned.
Add tomato sauce and remaining ingredients. Mix well and quickly bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer for 25 minutes.
notes: May add 1/2 cup shredded Parmesan cheese before serving.

pasta-grains-stuffed-shells.title: Stuffed Shells
directions: Grease a 9"x13" baking dish. Pour in enough spaghetti sauce to cover bottom of baking dish.
Cook manicotti according to package directions. (Pour cold water over shells and leave them in water until you stuff them.)
In a bowl mix ricotta cheese, 3 eggs, parsley, and shredded mozzarella (all but about 1/2 cup).
Stuff shells, place in pan over sauce, cover with remaining sauce, and top with remaining mozzarella cheese.
Cover pan with foil and bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

pies-cookies-anitas-delight.title: Anita's Delight

items: 2 boxes banana or chocolate instant pudding

directions: Crust: Pat in a 9"x12" pan, and bake for 20 min. at 350°F.
Cream Cheese Layer: Cream and spread over cooled crust.
Pudding Layer: Mix until thickened and spread over cream cheese mixture.
Top with Cool Whip, and top with crushed nuts.

pies-cookies-apple-crisp.title: Apple Crisp
directions: Peel and core enough apples that when quartered and sliced will fill 9"x11" pan 1/2 way up the sides.
In a bowl cut shortening (margarine) into flour, sugar, salt and cinnamon (mixture should be crumbly).
Place about 1/2" water in pan with apples, then sprinkle mixture above over the apples.
Bake for 1 hour at 350°F.

pies-cookies-brownies.title: Brownies
directions: In an 8"x8" pan, place 1 stick oleo and 2 squares of semi-sweet chocolate and melt in the oven.
Let cool, then add 2 beaten eggs, 1 cup sugar, and 3/4 cup flour.
Stir mixture with a fork and bake for 30 min at 350°F.

pies-cookies-caramel-corn.title: Caramel Corn
directions: Melt margarine in a large saucepan.
Stir in brown sugar, corn syrup, and salt, and bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Then boil without stirring for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in soda and vanilla.
Pour syrup over popcorn and stir until popcorn is thoroughly coated.
Bake at 250°F for 1 hour (covered), stirring every 15 minutes.
Spread on waxed paper and allow to cool.

pies-cookies-cherry-cheese-tarts.title: Cherry Cheese Tarts
directions: Beat cream cheese, eggs, sugar, and vanilla until smooth.
Put 24 cupcake papers in muffin tins. Place a vanilla wafer in each cupcake paper.
Divide batter and pour evenly over wafers.
Bake for 25 minutes at 350°F. (Color will be pale.)
Remove from papers and cool.
Place a small amount of cherry pie filling on each tart.

pies-cookies-chocolate-fondue.title: Chocolate Fondue
directions: In a fondue pot, melt chips and add whipping cream. (Add optional ingredients if desired.)
Stir until smooth.
notes: Use fresh strawberries, pineapple, cheese cake, angel food cake, marshmallows.

pies-cookies-chocolate-fudge.title: Chocolate Fudge
directions: Combine sugar, margarine, and milk in a heavy 2 1/2 qt. saucepan, and bring to a full rolling boil, stirring constantly.
Continue boiling another 5 minutes stirring constantly.
Remove from heat and stir in chocolate chips until melted.
Add marshmallow creme and vanilla, stirring until well-blended.
Pour into a greased 13"x9" pan.
Cool at room temperature, and cut into squares.
uncertain: 'Continue boiling another 5 minutes' — digit is overwritten and could be 5 or 8

pies-cookies-cream-caramels.title: Cream Caramels
directions: Bring sugar, corn syrup, butter, and 1 cup of cream slowly to a boil.
Gradually stir in remaining cup of whipping cream.
Cook (stirring constantly) until hard ball stage (254°F).
Pour into a buttered 8"x8" square pan that has been covered with 1/2 cup of chopped nuts.
When cold, cut into squares.

pies-cookies-dishpan-cookies.title: Dishpan Cookies
directions: Mix brown sugar, white sugar, vegetable oil, eggs, and vanilla thoroughly with beater.
Add flour, oats, cornflakes, soda, salt, and chocolate chips.
Drop by teaspoonfuls onto parchment covered baking sheets; bake at 350°F for 10-14 minutes.
Cool on baking rack.

pies-cookies-grandmas-sugar-cookies.title: Grandma's Sugar Cookies
directions: Cream oil, butter, and both sugars.
Add vanilla and eggs.
Sift dry ingredients and add to creamed mixture.
Roll tsp. of dough into a ball, roll ball in granulated sugar, and press down on greased cookie sheet with a glass that has been dipped in sugar.
Press with fork and bake at 350°F for 10-12 minutes.

pies-cookies-grasshopper-pie.title: Grasshopper Pie
directions: Mix cookie crumbs and butter and press into a 9" pie pan.
In a double boiler, melt 24 large marshmallows with 2/3 cup milk.
Let cool, then add 1/4 cup creme de menthe and 2 Tbsp. creme de cocoa.
Let cool until thickened, then add 1 cup Cool Whip.
Cover and store in freezer.

pies-cookies-hershey-bar-pie.title: Hershey Bar Pie
directions: Break bar into small pieces and melt in microwave or in a double-boiler on the stove.
Gradually fold melted Hershey Bar into 8 oz of Cool Whip.
Pour mixture into crust.
Top with remaining Cool Whip and chocolate shavings.
Refrigerate.
uncertain: '1 Oreo crust' — crust type is scrawled; reads like 'Oreo' but could be another word
'1 16 oz Hershey w/ Almond Bar' — bar size is unclear; '16 oz' is a best guess

pies-cookies-ice-cream-crunch.title: Ice Cream Crunch Pie
directions: Melt butter in heavy pan, then add marshmallows, stirring until well-mixed.
Add Rice Krispies and stir until well-coated.
Press mixture into a 9" pie pan.
Freeze crust for 1 hour, then fill with favorite ice cream, topping, and refreeze until serving time.

pies-cookies-molasses-cookies.title: Molasses Cookies
directions: Mix well oil, sugar, molasses, and egg.
Sift together flour, soda, salt, and spices; add to first mixture.
Mix well and chill.
Form into 1 inch balls, roll in sugar, and place on greased cookie sheet 2" apart.
Bake at 375°F for 8-10 minutes.

pies-cookies-oatmeal-crispers.title: Oatmeal Crispies
directions: Cream Crisco and sugars.
Add eggs and vanilla and beat well.
Add sifted dry ingredients.
Next, add oatmeal and nut meats.
Shape in rolls and wrap in waxed paper.
Chill thoroughly, and slice 1/4" thick and bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350°F for about 10 minutes.

pies-cookies-peach-cobbler.title: Peach Cobbler
directions: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Add egg yolks and melted Crisco. Mix well.
Beat egg whites until stiff and fold in mixture.
Drop over sliced, fresh peaches (sweetened).
Bake at 350°F for 35-40 minutes.

pies-cookies-peach-pie.title: Peach Pie
directions: Bring to a boil sugar, corn syrup, cornstarch, and water.
Boil for 5 minutes, then add 2 Tbsp. peach Jell-O, and cool.
Add 1 tsp. almond extract, mix, and fill a pie crust.
Bake at 350°F for 45 min to 1 hour.

pies-cookies-peanut-butter-balls.title: Peanut Butter Balls
directions: Mix above ingredients (with mixer), and shape into small balls.
In a double-boiler place 6 oz. of chocolate chips and 1/2 bar of paraffin - melt.
Dip peanut butter balls into chocolate mixture (using a fork) and place on wax paper to cool.
Store in container in the refrigerator.

pies-cookies-peanut-butter-cookies.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
directions: Cream Crisco and sugars.
Add egg, vanilla, and peanut butter. Blend well.
Mix in sifted flour, soda, and salt.
Shape into balls, roll in sugar, and press criss-cross marks with a fork.
Bake at 375°F for 10-15 minutes.

pies-cookies-peanut-butter-fudge.title: Peanut Butter Fudge
directions: Boil sugar and condensed milk until softball stage.
Remove from heat and add 1 cup peanut butter, and 1 7 oz. jar Marshmallow Creme.
Place in greased 9" x 11" pan.
Cool, cut into small squares.
Store in refrigerator until you serve it.

pies-cookies-pumpkin-pie.title: Pumpkin Pie
directions: Heat milk and add butter.
Mix the spices with the sugar.
Then add the molasses, pumpkin, and milk.
Next, add the eggs.
Pour into unbaked crust.
Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes, reduce heat to 350°F, and continue baking for another 45 minutes, or until custard is firm.

directions: Cook crushed berries, sugar, cornstarch, water, and lemon juice until transparent.

Serve with Cool Whip.

1/2 Tablespoon each of: paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, thyme, oregano, celery seed, and basil
1/4 tsp. each of: cayenne pepper, black pepper, white pepper, salt

Fish: Grill over medium heat 8-10 min. for salmon or until fish flakes easily.
Blackened Seasoning Mix: Blend all ingredients well.

poultry-seafood-chicken-with-squiggly-no.title: Chicken with Squiggly Noodles

directions: Shrimp: Mix together flour, sugar, salt, egg, ice water, and canola oil.

directions: Chicken: In deep frying pan fill up oil 1/3 way up pan. Make sure oil is real hot.

Chicken: If oil is really hot, cook 6 min. on each side.

Place in a baking pan.
Slice onion over chicken.
Then cut up tomatoes over onions.
Cover mixture with Italian Dressing.
Bake at 350°F (covered) for 1 hour.
Uncover and continue cooking for another 15 minutes.

poultry-seafood-moms-chicken-parmesan.title: Mom's Chicken Parmesan

items: Boneless, skinless chicken breasts (as many as you wish)

directions: Place chicken in baking pan and cover with spaghetti sauce.
Cover sauce with mozzarella cheese and top with fresh Parmesan.
Bake covered at 350°F for 1 hour.
Uncover and cook an additional 15 minutes.

poultry-seafood-overnight-chicken-casser.title: Overnight Chicken Casserole
directions: Mix together.
Place in large casserole and refrigerate overnight.
Remove from refrigerator, mix well, and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.

poultry-seafood-parmesan-chicken.title: Parmesan Chicken
directions: Brush chicken pieces with margarine, and roll in grated Parmesan cheese.
Bake in an 8" x 8" greased baking dish at 350°F for 1 hour.

salads-soups-baked-onion-soup.title: Baked Onion Soup
directions: Saute onions in margarine until clear.
Add flour, then beef bouillon.
Simmer about 1 hour. Then add sherry.
Grate all cheeses and mix together.
Slice bread, butter on both sides, sprinkle with Parmesan cheese, and broil until brown.
Divide onion mixture into 8 individual baking dishes.
Place toast on top and add cheeses.
Place baking dishes on cookie sheet and bake for 1 hour at 350°F.

salads-soups-baked-potato-soup.title: Baked Potato Soup
directions: Brown and drain the bacon.
Add half of the diced potatoes and brown.
Drain and add diced onions and bacon.
Add remaining potatoes & cover with water.
Season with seasoned salt and a little lemon pepper.
Cook for 2-3 hours until liquid is cooked down and then add milk.
Cook until hot.
Add 1 Tbsp. flour to thicken.
Serve with shredded cheddar cheese on top.

directions: Combine broccoli, bacon, green onions, raisins, and walnuts.
Mix together mayonnaise, sugar, and vinegar.
Pour over broccoli mixture, chill, and serve.

salads-soups-cheese-soup.title: Cheese Soup

items: 2 celery stalks (cook whole & remove before adding the cheese)

directions: Cook together chicken broth, onion, carrots, and celery for about 20 minutes.
Remove celery, add cheese.
Simmer until thoroughly heated (Do Not Boil).

salads-soups-chicken-egg-drop-soup.title: Chicken Egg Drop Soup
directions: In a large pan, heat chicken broth to boiling.
Blend cornstarch with water to make a smooth paste.
Stir in soy sauce and sugar.
Slowly stir into broth; bring to a boil and simmer until clear (stirring constantly).
Remove from heat.
Gradually add eggs, stirring until eggs separate into shreds.
Add green onions and season to taste.
Serve immediately.

salads-soups-chicken-soup.title: Chicken Soup
directions: Cook 4 whole chicken breasts in large stock pot (1/2 pot of water).

Cook about 1 1/2 hours, or until chicken is tender.
Remove chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces.

You may need to add additional water, and salt & pepper.

salads-soups-chili.title: Chili
directions: Brown together meat & onions.
Add 3 Tbsp. chili powder, & salt & pepper.
Drain mixture, add remaining ingredients and simmer for at least 4 hours.

salads-soups-cranberry-salad.title: Cranberry Salad

Grind cranberries and add 1-2 cups sugar.
Place both Jell-Os in a bowl and add boiling liquid to dissolve Jell-O.
Fold in oranges, apples, and cranberries, + add sugar.
Place in mold and chill.

salads-soups-five-cup-salad.title: Five-Cup Salad
directions: Mix together and refrigerate.

salads-soups-frozen-cranberry-salad.title: Frozen Cranberry Salad
directions: Mix ground cranberries, apples, and sugar.
Place in a bowl and refrigerate overnight.
Add Cool Whip and marshmallows.
Freeze.

salads-soups-layered-salad.title: Layered Salad
directions: Layer as listed above (except mix Miracle Whip and sugar together before covering): lettuce, celery, green peppers, onions, and peas.
Cover with Miracle Whip mixture, then cheese, and finally cooked bacon.
Cover with foil and refrigerate for 24 hours.

salads-soups-lemon-lime-salads.title: Lemon-Lime Salad
directions: Sprinkle dry jello over cottage cheese, stirring all the time.
Add 1 small can drained crushed pineapple.
Add 8 oz Cool Whip.
Refrigerate.

salads-soups-noahs-ark-clam-chowder.title: Noah's Ark Clam Chowder

1 can Campbell's Cr. of Potato Soup
1 can Campbell's Cr. of Celery Soup

directions: Heat thoroughly, but do not boil.

salads-soups-pistachio-salad.title: Pistachio Salad
directions: Mix together and refrigerate.

salads-soups-potato-soup.title: Potato Soup

items: 3 cups sliced or minced onions - or leek is preferred
1 quart stock and about 1 qt. milk (or chicken stock + milk)
1/3 to 1/2 cup sour cream and 2 to 3 Tbls. butter
2 to 3 Tbls. minced parsley or chives

directions: Melt butter over moderate heat and stir in onions. Cover pan and cook slowly for about 5 min. without browning.
Blend in the flour and stir for about 2 minutes to cook the flour without browning it.

Stir in the salt, pepper and potatoes. Bring to boiling and simmer partially covered for about 40 minutes until vegetables are tender.
When you are ready to serve add the milk and return to a simmer. Blend in as much of the cream as you wish. Add butter. Taste carefully adding more salt and pepper as needed.
Garnish with a spoonful of cream and a sprinkling of herbs.

Gently spoon on remaining strawberry mixture.

Pour jello mixture over cream cheese/pretzel crust.
Cover and refrigerate. Cut into squares and serve.

Stir in beans and tomatoes. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Remove from heat, stir in basil, balsamic vinegar, and salt.
Ladle into bowls, sprinkle with Parmesan cheese, & pepper.

salads-soups-vegetable-soup.title: Vegetable Soup

Simmer soup at least 4 hours.

Stir in gelatin, and continue stirring until gelatin dissolves.
When the mixture begins to set add cheese and nuts.
Chill for several hours.

Cover with milk.
Bake covered at 350°F for 1 hour.
Uncover and bake for another 30 minutes.

vegetables-cauliflower-with-cheese-sauce.title: Cauliflower with Cheese Sauce

Purée w/ a potato masher until desired consistency is reached. Add more buttermilk if necessary.
Season to taste w/ salt & black pepper.
Refrigerate in a covered container until ready to use.

Grease pan (use Pam) and pour mixture into a pan.
Melt 1 stick of butter and pour over the top.
Bake in 8" x 10" pan for 1 hour at 325°F. Bake less if top gets too brown.

vegetables-creamed-peas.title: Creamed Peas

items: 1 package frozen baby peas (cook as directed on package)

directions: Cook peas as directed on package.
Place flour into saucepan and gradually add milk. Stir constantly until thickened.
Add peas to thickened mixture, add margarine (about 2 Tbsp.), and salt and pepper to taste.

items: 4 medium tomatoes, peeled & chopped OR 1 - 1 pound can whole tomatoes, chopped & drained

Add remaining ingredients and cook slightly.

vegetables-golden-parmesan-potatoes.title: Golden Parmesan Potatoes

Bake @ 400°F for 45 min.

Bake in oven at 425°F for 45-60 min.

Uncover and continue baking for another 30 minutes.

Mash potatoes with milk.

Pour into 1 1/2 quart casserole dish (greased), & place 4 slices of butter on top.
Bake @ 350°F for 1 hour.
